M16 — 2026-10-09
CORRECTION of r4-fixes M15: never reuse a previous release's native cores. build.rs bakes the package version into the binary as the engine key for fold snapshots and the digest cache, so a copied core keys its caches to the old version. 0.34.2 shipped 0.34.1-keyed cores: output stays correct, but mixed TS/native use throws away each other's caches. Build the cores in CI instead: push the branch, `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <branch> -f baseline=<prev>`, then `gh run download <id> -p 'sofar-core-*' -D DIR`, rename each to DIR/<target>/, and run `emit.mjs --binaries DIR`. digest-cache.test.ts only checks this when target/release/sofar-core exists.
